description: This file defines the StudentGroup class and related functions for managing student groups within an education module, including validation, enrollment retrieval, and student fetching.

classes.name: StudentGroup
classes.description: Represents a student group with validation and child table management methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the student group before saving.

methods.name: validate_mandatory_fields
methods.description: Checks that mandatory fields are filled based on group criteria.

methods.name: validate_strength
methods.description: Ensures the maximum strength is non-negative and not exceeded.

methods.name: validate_students
methods.description: Validates each student in the group for activity status and enrollment.

methods.name: validate_and_set_child_table_fields
methods.description: Assigns roll numbers and student names, checks for duplicate roll numbers.

search-terms: group based on course or batch
